about: Where each fixture in this folder came from (the effects planner, light planner and camera audit tests, log 35). WORKING is the project's working files from the redesign rounds (never in the repository; the tests read them through FILM_WORKING_FILES); FILM is the project's film kit (austerity-explainer/film-kit). Copied or measured on 2026-10-16. Nothing here is larger than 200 KB (the whole camera logs are gzipped).
round4-smoke.json: FILM paper-film/scenes/inflation-chapter-2-newcomers/works-effects.js at git commit 60d1f1a (round 4): its SMOKE and WIND, read with plan_effects.read_smoke_from_page_code
round5-smoke-final.json: WORKING/redesign/round5-pages/tools/smoke-final.json (round 5's traced smoke settings), with each kind's colour and count added from works-effects.js SMOKE as it stood in round 5

beam-notice-glow.json: Measured with kit/paper-film/blender/set_measurements.py beam in FILM/assets/models/pit-village/notice-corner.blend: the notice glow at (2.78, 22.0, 2.6301) aimed at (3.45, 22.75, 2.3251), cone 50 degrees (notice-corner-shot.json notice_glow), 145 rays, out to 4 m
street-lamps.json: Measured with kit/paper-film/blender/set_measurements.py objects --match "gas_lamp_*" in FILM/assets/models/pit-village/street.blend (the street builder's lamps before assemble_notice_corner.py removed two and dimmed one)
